notes: IBM's CICS asynchronous API credit-card example: UPDCSDB (transaction UPDB, the customer-database cache update) is one of the eight services ASYNCPNT starts in parallel (RUN TRANSID) and SEQPNT LINKs to in sequence. It stands in for a slow back end: DELAY FOR SECONDS(3), then RETURN. Its LINKAGE SECTION is empty -- it takes no COMMAREA ("commarea": null, #4270: EIBCALEN 0 on both sides; the det service is handleLink()). The RETURN is compared; the DELAY changes nothing a task can see (a task takes no time, oracle_assumptions.md X4) and is not an event on either side. There is no branch. scenarios.name: delay-then-return
scenarios.why: no COMMAREA (EIBCALEN 0): DELAY FOR SECONDS(3) NORMAL, then RETURN -- the whole program; the RETURN (no TRANSID, no COMMAREA) is its one event
